race.comment: LOW BLOCK (3) carved over from wide out and boxed on strongly to finish a neck away in second (19.62) behind Master Your Mind at this track. One of the leading chances. ARCHIE MCIVOR (6) racing well without winning, placing at his last four runs. Last start finished 2nd on November 6 over 350m at this track behind Diplomat beaten 1.3 lengths (19.59) in a Grade 5. Goes well out of this box with a win and five minor placings. Expected to feature again. BLAME KARISSA (1) trailed the lead and fought on well to be beaten a long neck into second (24.13) at Bendigo in a Grade 5 over 425m. Expected to be in the finish again. JUSTIFIED JIM (2) is not to be discarded.
